normative_extracts.spec_section: 4. Suppressing An Element’s Contents: the content-visibility property
normative_extracts.quote: When content-visibility is auto, the user agent skips the element’s contents when it is not relevant to the user, applying size, layout, and paint containment.

browser_support.notes: Baseline Newly Available (2024). Progressive enhancement: unsupported browsers simply render normally.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Engine tracks intersection proximity; irrelevant subtrees skip Layout and Paint while preserving find-in-page and accessibility tree indexing.

production_failures.symptom: Scrollbar thumb jumps erratically while scrolling down a long page
production_failures.root_cause: Off-screen sections with content-visibility: auto collapse to 0px height when contain-intrinsic-size is omitted.
production_failures.mitigation: Pair content-visibility: auto with contain-intrinsic-size: auto <estimated-height>.

production_failures.symptom: Scrolling stutters right before a heavy section enters the viewport
production_failures.root_cause: A single massive section (e.g., 5,000 rows) becomes relevant all at once and triggers a 120ms layout burst.
production_failures.mitigation: Chunk long lists into smaller wrapper sections of 20-50 items each.
